summary: SIEM feed c026_span is losing 61.51% of packets due to SPAN oversubscription: 2.60 Gbps mirrored from LEAF-07 Gi1/0/1 into 1 Gbps SPAN destination LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48.

findings.root_cause: SPAN oversubscription at LEAF-07: SPAN session should copy 48,712,440 packets from LEAF-07 Gi1/0/1 (mirrored) but destination LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 sent only 18,750,000. 2.60 Gbps mirrored into a 1 Gbps destination port, destination discarded 29,962,500 packets on output (average load 100% of 1 Gbps, bursts higher) = 61.51% loss. SPAN is best-effort copy and drops when ingress exceeds destination capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM misses ~61.5% of events/flows - detection coverage severely degraded, correlation and alerting blind to majority of traffic despite SIEM tolerating single-direction and truncated payload (needs_both_directions=false, needs_full_payload=false).

params.broker_action: filter/aggregate to fit 1 Gbps SIEM port

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, out-of-band copy unlike SPAN which drops under oversubscription. Replace SPAN with TAP at LEAF-07 Gi1/0/1 and front with packet broker to filter to SIEM-relevant traffic (SIEM does not need both directions or full payload) or aggregate/load-balance so sustained rate fits the 1 Gbps tool port; otherwise even a TAP will still overrun the 1 Gbps SIEM feed.
